How much does insurance cost and what affects the premium?

Premiums vary based on coverage type, sum assured, age, health condition, occupation, and location. GST of 18% is applicable on most insurance premiums. The key factors affecting premiums are sum assured requirements, age, health, and coverage duration.

How do I know which insurance is best for my family?

The best insurance depends on your family size, age, income, existing assets, health conditions, and goals. I provide personalized advisory based on your unique situation, comparing multiple insurer options to find the most suitable coverage.

What documents are needed for insurance claims?

Required documents typically include: completed claim form, original policy document, medical reports/invoices, FIR and police report, death certificate, and proof of identity. I assist with claim filing, document preparation, and follow-up.

Can you help with policy review and switching?

Yes, policy review and switching is one of our specialties. We compare multiple insurers using our expertise in policy comparison, ensuring you don't lose continuity of coverage. We handle all the paperwork and coordination.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to the most common questions about insurance planning and our services.

How much does insurance cost and what affects the premium?

Premiums vary based on coverage type, sum assured, age, health condition, occupation, and location. GST of 18% is applicable on most insurance premiums. For life insurance, terms under 5 years are typically tax-free. Health insurance premiums include GST, and NCB (No Claim Bonus) can reduce motor insurance costs. Personal accident insurance is affordable starting from just ₹10 per day. The key factors affecting premiums are sum assured requirements, age, health, and coverage duration.

How do I know which insurance is best for my family and needs?

The best insurance depends on your family size, age, income, existing assets, health conditions, and goals. For families with children, consider term insurance with child riders for education funding. For health coverage, choose between individual and family floater plans based on budget. Motor insurance should include third-party liability and comprehensive coverage. Personal accident insurance is crucial for working adults. I provide personalized advisory based on your unique situation, comparing multiple insurer options to find the most suitable coverage at competitive premiums.

What documents are needed for insurance claims and the process?

Required documents typically include: completed claim form, original policy document, medical reports/invoices (health insurance), FIR and police report (motor theft/accident), death certificate (life insurance), admission letter and bills (hospitalization), doctor prescriptions, and proof of identity/address. The process involves immediate intimation to insurer, claim registration, document submission, verification by insurer, claim settlement, and final disbursement. I assist with claim filing, document preparation, and follow-up with insurers to ensure smooth and timely settlement, achieving success rates above 95%.

Can you help with existing policy review and switching insurers?

Yes, policy review and switching is one of our specialties. We analyze your existing policy for better terms, coverage gaps, and potential savings. Switching can be beneficial if you find better premium rates, higher sum assured, better claim settlement ratio, or more favorable policy terms. We compare multiple insurers using our expertise in policy comparison, ensuring you don't lose continuity of coverage. We handle all the paperwork and coordination with new insurers, ensuring a smooth transition without service gaps.

What is the difference between term insurance and whole life insurance?

Term insurance provides coverage for a specified period (10-40 years) with lower premiums, paying a fixed sum if death occurs during the term. Whole life insurance provides lifelong coverage with premiums that increase with age, includes cash value accumulation, and continues until age 99. Term is suitable for those seeking high coverage at low cost for specific financial goals like children's education or mortgage protection. Whole life is better for those seeking lifelong protection plus an investment component, though premiums are significantly higher. I recommend term insurance for most people, with whole life for those seeking both protection and savings.

How often should I review my insurance policies and with whom?

It's recommended to review insurance policies annually, especially after life changes like marriage, birth of children, career changes, or major financial decisions. Review when changing jobs, relocating, or when insurance companies announce new rates. I offer complimentary reviews for existing clients twice a year, plus free reviews after any major life event. Regular reviews ensure your coverage matches your current needs, identify potential savings through comparisons, discover underinsurance or over-insurance, and ensure claim benefits remain adequate. Professional review is preferred over DIY comparisons for optimal coverage and cost-effectiveness.
